description: Sey Morphe Patches: KICK (Android TV) + Twitch (Android TV) - SEYTTINGS, EMOTES, CHAT SIZE, CHAT TEXT SIZE, EXPAND CHAT, HIDE PINNED, SKIP 18+ WARNING, AD BLOCK and AMOLED

patches.name: CHAT SIZE
patches.description: Resize the chat in the VIDEO/CHAT view: default (100%), 125%, 90%, 85% and 80%. The video and the chat panel always meet at the same edge. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: CHAT TEXT SIZE
patches.description: Render chat messages with a larger, Twitch-like TV text size. Pick 16 sp (default), 15 sp, 13 sp or the stock 11 sp in SEYTTINGS. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: EMOTES
patches.description: Shows 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes in the KICK TV chat. One toggle in SEYTTINGS enables or disables all providers. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: EXPAND CHAT
patches.description: Hides the "Join the Chat" footer in the VIDEO/CHAT view and lets the chat fill the freed space. Toggle it in SEYTTINGS. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: HIDE PINNED
patches.description: Removes the pinned message card (and the ad banner attached to it) from the top of the KICK TV chat. Toggle it in SEYTTINGS. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: SKIP 18+ WARNING
patches.description: Automatically accepts the 18+ mature content warning when a stream opens, so the player starts without the extra click. Toggle it in SEYTTINGS. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: SEYTTINGS
patches.description: Adds the red themed SEYTTINGS menu to KICK TV. This is the base patch required by every KICK TV tweak.

patches.name: AMOLED
patches.description: Pure black theme for the Twitch TV chat and the bars above and below the video. Replaces the dark greys with #000000. One toggle in SEYTTINGS. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: AD BLOCK
patches.description: Skips Twitch ads by filtering stitched ad segments from the HLS stream and switching to the same broadcast from an ad-free player type. One toggle in SEYTTINGS. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: EMOTES
patches.description: Shows 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes in the Twitch TV chat. One toggle in SEYTTINGS enables or disables all providers. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: EXPAND CHAT
patches.description: Hides the "Join the conversation" footer button and lets the chat fill the full panel height. One toggle in SEYTTINGS. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: HIDE PINNED
patches.description: Hides pinned chat messages on Twitch TV: the pinned card, its "Pinned by" label, the pin badge and any pinned highlight in the message list. One toggle in SEYTTINGS. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: SKIP 18+ WARNING
patches.description: Automatically accepts the 18+ mature content warning on Twitch TV, so a mature stream starts without the extra click. One toggle in SEYTTINGS. Requires the SEYTTINGS patch.

patches.name: SEYTTINGS
patches.description: Adds the red themed SEYTTINGS menu to Twitch TV. The Settings row opens a native patched-tweaks dialog. This is the base patch required by every Twitch TV tweak.

release_notes:
### ✨ New Features

* **KICK: Live Streaming - HIDE PINNED:** Added a SEYTTINGS toggle that removes the pinned message card and the ad banner attached to it from the top of the chat.
* **KICK: Live Streaming - SKIP 18+ WARNING:** Added a SEYTTINGS toggle that auto-accepts the 18+ mature content warning, so a mature stream starts without the extra click.
* **Twitch - SKIP 18+ WARNING:** Added a SEYTTINGS toggle that auto-accepts the 18+ mature content warning, so a mature stream starts without the extra click.
* **Twitch - HIDE PINNED:** Added a SEYTTINGS toggle that hides the pinned message card above the chat, its "Pinned by" label, the pin badge and any pinned highlight in the message list.
